scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory backend mypy && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest && npm run test -w frontend && node --test "tools/*.test.mjs"
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend lint-imports && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --directory backend ruff check --fix . && npm run lint -w frontend -- --fix
scripts.format: uv run --directory backend ruff format . && npm run format -w frontend
scripts.format:check: uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && npm run format:check -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run openspec:check && npm run test:e2e
